headline: Attackers exploited PaperCut, Langflow, JFrog, and Rails flaws within days of disclosure while breaches at Aesto Health, Nutex, and Novocure exposed millions of patient records.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers moved within days of public disclosure to hit PaperCut, Langflow, Ruby on Rails, and JFrog Artifactory, leaving unpatched enterprises exposed before their maintenance windows arrive.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Enterprise and Developer Tools Under Active Exploitation

emerging_trends.text: Healthcare technology providers keep bleeding patient records, with Aesto Health alone exposing 9.5 million people and Nutex Health and Novocure disclosing thefts of cancer-patient and employee data.

AI has become both prize and weapon, as thieves drained roughly $600,000 in credits from METR and Russia-aligned UAC-0099 seeded malware with a nuclear-weapon prompt to trip model guardrails and blind automated analysis.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Attackers Target and Subvert AI Systems

topics.title: Enterprise and Developer Tools Under Active Exploitation
topics.latest_developments: CISA added PaperCut flaws CVE-2026-82078 and CVE-2026-81578 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog as attackers turned them to data theft, VulnCheck caught live exploitation of Langflow's CVE-2026-0768 and Ruby on Rails' CVE-2026-66066, JFrog Artifactory's authentication-bypass CVE-2026-82329 drew attacks days after disclosure, and WatchGuard patched three critical Fireware OS flaws.
topics.summary: The flaws let unauthenticated attackers run code or bypass authentication on print servers, AI app builders, web frameworks, artifact repositories, and firewalls; administrators should patch at once and hunt for intrusion.

sources.title: Recently patched PaperCut zero-days used in data theft attacks
Attackers Exploit Critical Langflow and Rails Flaws in Credential-Probing and C2 Activity
Critical JFrog Artifactory Vulnerability Reportedly Exploited in the Wild
WatchGuard Patches Critical Vulnerabilities

topics.title: Healthcare Data Breaches Multiply
topics.latest_developments: Nutex Health of Houston told the SEC that a ransomware gang stole patient, employee, provider, and financial data and made an extortion demand, Novocure reported a mid-August attack that exposed more than 1,400 US cancer patients along with employees, and Aesto Health disclosed that hackers pulled personal and health information on 9.5 million people from its AWS infrastructure.
topics.summary: Three healthcare technology firms disclosed August intrusions; affected patients should watch for identity theft and medical fraud and act on breach notifications.

sources.title: 9.5 Million Impacted by Aesto Health Data Breach
Healthcare facilities operator Nutex says patient, employee data stolen in August incident
Novocure data breach affects more than 1,400 cancer patients
Ransomware Gang Claims Nutex Health Data Breach

topics.title: Mirage Kitten Strikes Aviation and Fintech
topics.latest_developments: Kaspersky published a full report naming the Iranian group Mirage Kitten, also tracked as Nimbus Manticore, and detailed its Node.js RAT NodeRabbit and JavaScript RAT PollCat striking aviation and FinTech developers across the Middle East and Africa, with the first NodeRabbit sighting in Afghanistan and later variants in Egypt and Ethiopia.
topics.summary: The Iranian espionage crew poses as recruiters handing developers coding tests that drop cross-platform remote access trojans reaching Linux and macOS; targeted developers should distrust unsolicited coding assignments.

sources.title: Mirage Kitten targeting aviation and FinTech sectors across the Middle East and Africa with a new malware set
Iranian cyber spies target aviation, fintech developers with new malware
Iranian Hackers Pose as Recruiters to Deliver Cross-Platform RATs Through Coding Tests

topics.title: Attackers Target and Subvert AI Systems
topics.latest_developments: METR, the nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models, said external actors stole an API key and burned roughly $600,000 in AI credits across two intrusion attempts, and ESET tied Russia-aligned UAC-0099 to GuardBreaker, a technique that plants a nuclear-weapon prompt in malware to trip a large language model's safety filters and derail AI-assisted analysis of a Ukrainian target.
topics.summary: Attackers now steal AI compute and manipulate model guardrails; organizations should lock down API keys and treat AI analysis output as tamperable.

sources.title: Attackers Steal METR API Key and Consume AI Credits Worth About $600,000
Russia-Aligned UAC-0099 Plants Nuclear Weapon Prompt in Malware to Disrupt AI Analysis

topics.title: Virtualizor Supply Chain Hit via BGP Hijack
topics.latest_developments: Hackers hijacked BGP routing for the Virtualizor VPS management software's update infrastructure, redirected update requests to servers they controlled, and pushed a malicious update to customers.
topics.summary: Virtualizor lets hosting providers manage virtual private servers; the BGP hijack let attackers impersonate the update server and slip malware onto customer systems, so operators should audit hosts that pulled recent updates.

sources.title: Hackers push malicious Virtualizor update in BGP hijacking attack

topics.title: Leaked Files Expose Russian Cyber Force Generation
topics.latest_developments: Leaked Russian training materials, reported by Schneier on Security, describe a force-generation system for General Staff components including the GRU, the Main Operational Directorate, and the 8th Directorate, and link 2024 Department No. 4 graduate Aleksei Kondrashov to Military Unit 74455, the destructive-attack group known as Sandworm.
topics.summary: The records map how Russia staffs its military cyber units and connect a named graduate to Sandworm, the unit behind some of Russia's most destructive cyberattacks.

sources.title: Leaked Russian Cyber-Operations Training Materials

business_politics.title: U.S. Launches Fresh Strikes on Iran
business_politics.latest_developments: The U.S. military said today it is hitting new Iranian targets in retaliation for Iranian attacks on commercial ships and American service members, and oil jumped nearly 4%.
business_politics.summary: The renewed fighting revives fears of a prolonged Persian Gulf conflict and fresh disruption to oil moving through the Strait of Hormuz, where attackers this week struck tankers carrying Saudi and South Korean crude; President Trump has summoned U.S. refiners to a White House meeting Tuesday over rising fuel prices as high living costs sap his standing before the midterms.

business_politics.title: Global Bond Sell-Off Deepens
business_politics.latest_developments: Japanese government-bond yields climbed to peaks unseen since the 1990s and U.K. borrowing costs hit their highest since 2008, dragging U.S. stocks lower as rising oil feeds inflation fears.
business_politics.summary: Sovereign borrowing costs are surging worldwide, heaping pressure on governments, home buyers, and credit-card holders, with the runup squeezing the Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank—which is set to raise rates next week after August eurozone inflation reached 3.3%.

business.title: U.S. Steel, Steelworkers Extend Talks
business.latest_developments: U.S. Steel, Cleveland-Cliffs, and the United Steelworkers agreed to a 30-day extension of their four-year labor contracts, which expired Tuesday morning, to keep negotiating.
business.summary: The extension keeps thousands of Western Pennsylvania mill workers under the expired terms and averts an immediate break between the United Steelworkers and two of the region's largest steel employers while talks continue.

business.title: Chobani Plans $1.2B Pennsylvania Plant
business.latest_developments: Chobani said it will build a $1.2 billion dairy manufacturing operation in the Lehigh Valley of Eastern Pennsylvania.
business.summary: The yogurt maker's investment adds a large food-manufacturing footprint to eastern Pennsylvania, one of the state's biggest recent industrial commitments.

sources.title: Chobani plans to build $1.2B dairy manufacturing operation in Eastern Pa.

business.title: Kraft Heinz Moves to NYSE
business.latest_developments: Kraft Heinz is leaving Nasdaq for the New York Stock Exchange, though it will retain some ties to Nasdaq.
business.summary: Kraft Heinz, dual-headquartered in Pittsburgh and Chicago, is shifting its stock listing to the New York Stock Exchange.

sources.title: Exchange transition: Kraft Heinz departs Nasdaq for a new home on the NYSE

around_town.title: Lawmakers Revive Property-Tax Elimination
around_town.latest_developments: Pennsylvania legislators reintroduced a plan to abolish school property taxes statewide and replace the revenue with higher sales and income taxes.
around_town.summary: The renewed push aims to end the school property taxes squeezing Pittsburgh-area homeowners, as Harrisburg still searches for a durable way to fund the state's public schools.

sources.title: Goodbye, property taxes? Legislators resurrect plan for shift to higher sales and income taxes

around_town.title: Oakland Restaurant Ordered Closed
around_town.latest_developments: Allegheny County ordered Hunan Bar on Atwood Street in Oakland closed after it failed to resolve multiple repeat health violations first cited during an August 21 inspection tied to a smoking complaint.
around_town.summary: The closure pulls a Chinese restaurant in the heart of Oakland's student district off-line until it corrects the recurring violations.

sources.title: Pittsburgh Chinese restaurant ordered closed after failing to resolve multiple repeat violations

around_town.title: Allegheny County Sprays for West Nile
around_town.latest_developments: Allegheny County is continuing to spray neighborhoods to knock down mosquitoes carrying West Nile virus, the leading mosquito-borne disease in the country.
around_town.summary: The county's spraying targets infected mosquito populations as the late-summer transmission season runs on.

sources.title: Allegheny County continues to spray neighborhoods to reduce West Nile Virus

events.title: Merged Theaters Named Confluence Theater
events.latest_developments: The company formed by the merger of Pittsburgh Public Theater and Pittsburgh CLO announced its name, Confluence Theater of Pittsburgh, along with a plan for its future.
events.summary: The combined nonprofit unites two of Pittsburgh's largest stage companies under one banner, Confluence Theater of Pittsburgh, reshaping the city's professional-theater landscape.

around_teams.latest_developments: On Cam Heyward's "Not Just Football," outside linebackers T.J. Watt, Alex Highsmith, Nick Herbig, and Jack Sawyer discussed their offseason contracts and adjusting to a new defensive system.
around_teams.summary: The training-camp episode gathered the full edge-rusher room to break down life under the Steelers' revamped defense and play a round of position-group superlatives.

team_usa.latest_developments: U.S. women's national team midfielder Rose Lavelle re-signed with defending NWSL champion Gotham FC through the 2029 season.
team_usa.summary: The extension keeps one of the USWNT's most creative midfielders with the reigning NWSL title-holder in New York/New Jersey for four more seasons.

team_usa.latest_developments: Stoke City is in the final stages of acquiring U.S. men's national team midfielder Jack McGlynn from the Houston Dynamo for a fee of up to $5.5 million.
team_usa.summary: The transfer moves McGlynn from MLS to the English Championship, extending a wave of young American players heading to Europe before the deadline.

team_usa.summary: Lawson's assessment comes as the American team enters the tournament without A'ja Wilson and Kelsey Plum, both sidelined for health reasons, with Kiki Iriafen and Sonia Citron called in as replacements.
